what_this_is: Every sentence the page builds from data. Each reason is a count or a quote. Ages are as of the day the boards were checked. The wording test runs over this file.

group_meaning.needs_person: Something is unclear, so a person checks first.
group_meaning.skipped: Ruled out by a check, as of [d].

reasons.DATES_CLUSTERED: [count] postings here are dated within 14 days of each other, so the dates may not tell new jobs from old. A person opens two and checks whether the whole board was reposted at once.
reasons.NOT_READ: A posting could not be read, or the line the AI picked is not in it. A person reads it.
reasons.MODEL_UNSURE: The AI wasn't sure [what]. A person reads the posting.
reasons.NO_RULE_FITS: No check fits this company. A person reads it.
reasons.READ_AS_OTHER_WORK: The AI read [n] job title[s] with a delivery word as [kinds].
reasons.NO_DELIVERY_OPERATION_SHOWN: The postings the AI read don't show the company running delivery, fleet or field work, itself or through carriers it manages.
reasons.OLDER_COPIES_OPEN: [k] delivery jobs have new postings, but each was first posted at the company more than 90 days ago, so they count as reposts.
reasons.SEASONAL: The only new delivery jobs say seasonal or temporary.
reasons.OUTSIDE_US: None of the delivery jobs read is in the US, or the location couldn't be read.
reasons.OPEN_A_WHILE: The newest posting for a job the AI read as delivery work is [nd] old.
reasons.NOTHING_NEW: The newest posting for a job the AI read as delivery work is [nd] old.
reasons.NOTHING_NEW_UNREAD: The newest posting with a delivery word in its title is [nd] old.
reasons.NONE_QUALIFY: Each new delivery job here is outside the US, seasonal, an old job reposted, or one the AI did not read as delivery work at this company.
reasons.PLACE_UNCLEAR: The AI read this as delivery work, but the only location given is "[place]", so it may not be a US job. A person checks.
reasons.MORE_READY: [n] other new job[s] [v] the same checks.
reasons.OLDER_COPIES_ONE: 1 delivery job has a new posting, but it was first posted at the company more than 90 days ago, so it counts as a repost.

brief.set_apart: [n] delivery job postings on this board are for a second business that does different work. Left out.
brief.local_brands: [n] of [b] postings on this board are listed under other business names.

brief.new_roles_clustered: New by the board's dates: [k] of [r] (posted in the last 30 days, or 60 for a leadership role).

notes.ask: How are these routes planned and handed to drivers today?
notes.do_not_assume: That anything is wrong, or that they're looking for software.
notes.buyers_note: The people who post driver jobs are rarely the buyers. This contact is my guess, based on the company's market.

ask_by_kind.fleet_management: While you hire a [title], which vehicles, drivers and jobs are tracked in one place today, and which are not?
ask_by_kind.field_technician: While you hire technicians[in_place], what happens today when a job runs long or a technician runs late?
